summary: Compute overlap coefficients for explicit candidate vertex pairs.
result_schemas_json: {"call_specific_authority":"cugraph_validate_call","default_schema":"default","note":"Generic registry schemas; run cugraph_validate_call for the concrete table-specific output schema.","schemas":{"default":{"fields":[{"data_type":"Int64","name":"first","nullable":false},{"data_type":"Int64","name":"second","nullable":false},{"data_type":"Float64","name":"similarity","nullable":false}]}}}
options_schema_json: {"algorithm_options":{"first_vertex_col":{"column_of":"vertex_pairs_table","description":"First endpoint column in vertex_pairs_table.","expected_type_ref":"vertex_pairs_domain","required":true,"scope":"side_input","type":"Utf8"},"second_vertex_col":{"column_of":"vertex_pairs_table","description":"Second endpoint column in vertex_pairs_table.","expected_type_ref":"vertex_pairs_domain","required":true,"scope":"side_input","type":"Utf8"},"vertex_pairs_table":{"description":"Table or view containing the explicit candidate vertex pairs.","required":true,"scope":"side_input","side_input":{"column_options":["first_vertex_col","second_vertex_col"],"role":"vertex_pairs"},"type":"Utf8"}},"graph_options":{"construction_policy":{"allowed_values":["python_cugraph","raw_libcugraph"],"default":"python_cugraph","description":"Edge-list construction semantics used before calling libcugraph.","scope":"graph","type":"Utf8"},"directed":{"allowed_values":[false],"default":false,"description":"Whether graph construction treats edges as directed.","scope":"graph","type":"Boolean","valid_when":"required false: similarity operates on an undirected/symmetric graph"},"renumber":{"default":true,"description":"Whether graph construction may renumber external vertex identifiers internally.","scope":"graph","type":"Boolean"}},"type_aliases":{"vertex_domain":"same Int32 or Int64 domain as src_col and dst_col","vertex_pairs_domain":"same physical Int32 or Int64 dtype as vertex_domain"}}
argument_descriptions_json: [{"name":"table_name","required":true,"type":"Utf8"},{"default":"src","name":"src_col","required":false,"type":"Utf8"},{"default":"dst","name":"dst_col","required":false,"type":"Utf8"},{"name":"weight_col","note":"optional edge weight column for graph construction when supported by the algorithm","required":false,"semantic_effect":"edge weights affect algorithm results when provided","type":"Utf8|null"},{"name":"options_json","note":"required: identifies the explicit candidate-pair relation with vertex_pairs_table, first_vertex_col, and second_vertex_col","required":true,"type":"Utf8"}]
result_field_descriptions_json: [{"description":"First vertex from the explicit candidate-pair relation.","name":"first"},{"description":"Second vertex from the explicit candidate-pair relation.","name":"second"},{"description":"Similarity coefficient for the explicit candidate pair.","name":"similarity"}]
limitations_json: ["dry-run validates table resolution, column presence, static dtypes, and options only","dry-run does not scan edge data, construct a graph, or prove source-vertex existence","similarity is explicit-pair only; all-pairs candidate generation and all-pairs top-k search are not exposed","options_json must name vertex_pairs_table, first_vertex_col, and second_vertex_col","candidate-pair columns must share the same Int32 or Int64 dtype and match the graph vertex domain","null candidate-pair values are rejected at execution and are never dropped","candidate pairs are a multiset: duplicate, reversed, and self pairs remain distinct output rows","result rows have no global ordering; use ORDER BY when order is required","providing weight_col selects weighted similarity; omitting it selects unit-weight similarity","cuGraph requires directed=false so the graph is constructed as an undirected/symmetric view"]
